/bin/zsh -lc "cat > generated_tests.keel <<'EOF'
// Add regression tests here.

test \"equal timestamps are never fresh\" {
    assert "'!is_fresh(0, 0)
    assert !is_fresh(1, 1)
    assert !is_fresh(-1, -1)
    assert !is_fresh(9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807)
    assert !is_fresh(-9223372036854775807 - 1, -9223372036854775807 - 1)
}

test "adjacent timestamps preserve strict ordering" {
    assert is_fresh(0, 1)
    assert !is_fresh(1, 0)
    assert is_fresh(-1, 0)
    assert !is_fresh(0, -1)
    assert is_fresh(-2, -1)
    assert !is_fresh(-1, -2)
    assert is_fresh(41, 42)
    assert !is_fresh(42, 41)
    assert is_fresh(-42, -41)
    assert !is_fresh(-41, -42)
}

test "ordering at signed timestamp limits" {
    let minimum = -9223372036854775807 - 1
    let maximum = 9223372036854775807
    assert is_fresh(minimum, minimum + 1)
    assert !is_fresh(minimum + 1, minimum)
    assert is_fresh(maximum - 1, maximum)
    assert !is_fresh(maximum, maximum - 1)
    assert is_fresh(minimum, maximum)
    assert !is_fresh(maximum, minimum)
    assert is_fresh(minimum, 0)
    assert !is_fresh(0, minimum)
    assert is_fresh(-1, maximum)
    assert !is_fresh(maximum, -1)
    assert is_fresh(0, maximum)
    assert !is_fresh(maximum, 0)
}

test "signed ordering across wide gaps" {
    assert is_fresh(-1, 1)
    assert !is_fresh(1, -1)
    assert is_fresh(-7000000000000000000, 7000000000000000000)
    assert !is_fresh(7000000000000000000, -7000000000000000000)
    assert is_fresh(-7000000000000000000, -3000000000000000000)
    assert !is_fresh(-3000000000000000000, -7000000000000000000)
    assert is_fresh(3000000000000000000, 7000000000000000000)
    assert !is_fresh(7000000000000000000, 3000000000000000000)
}

test "ordering retains timestamp bits above 32 bits" {
    assert is_fresh(2147483647, 2147483648)
    assert !is_fresh(2147483648, 2147483647)
    assert is_fresh(-2147483649, -2147483648)
    assert !is_fresh(-2147483648, -2147483649)
    assert is_fresh(1, 4294967297)
    assert !is_fresh(4294967297, 1)
    assert is_fresh(-4294967297, -1)
    assert !is_fresh(-1, -4294967297)
}
EOF
python3 workflow.py validate'
